title: A Small Shelter in the School Garden
title_ja: 学校の庭の小さなすみか

source_links.title: Original fictional lesson — project authoring provenance, not factual evidence

fact_notes: 完全オリジナルの架空事例。実在の学校・人物・調査結果を示さない。リンクは制作方針の来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A science club wanted to make a corner of its school garden friendlier to small animals.
sentences.ja: 科学部は学校の庭の一角を小さな動物にとって過ごしやすくしたいと考えました。

sentences.en: The students first planned to buy a large wooden shelter from a shop.
sentences.ja: 生徒たちは最初、店で大きな木製のすみかを買う予定でした。

sentences.en: However, their teacher asked them to look carefully at what was already growing there.
sentences.ja: しかし先生はすでにそこに生えているものを注意深く見るよう求めました。

sentences.en: Under a low bush, they found dry leaves and a few fallen branches.
sentences.ja: 低い茂みの下で、乾いた葉と落ちた枝を数本見つけました。

sentences.en: Instead of removing everything, they decided to keep some leaves in a quiet part of the garden.
sentences.ja: すべて取り除く代わりに、庭の静かな部分に葉を少し残すことにしました。

sentences.en: They put a small sign beside the area so that other students would know why it looked different.
sentences.ja: 他の生徒がそこだけ見た目が違う理由を知るよう、小さな看板をそばに置きました。

sentences.en: For several weeks, the club visited the corner at the same time every Friday.
sentences.ja: 数週間、部員は毎週金曜の同じ時間にその一角を訪れました。

sentences.en: They wrote down what they saw, but they did not touch or move the animals.
sentences.ja: 見たものを記録しましたが、動物を触ったり動かしたりしませんでした。

sentences.en: One day, they noticed a tiny insect hiding under a leaf after the rain.
sentences.ja: ある日、雨の後に小さな昆虫が葉の下に隠れていることに気づきました。

sentences.en: The students could not tell whether their work had increased the number of animals in the garden.
sentences.ja: 自分たちの活動で庭の動物の数が増えたかどうかは分かりませんでした。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, they learned to notice useful things that they might once have thrown away.
sentences.ja: それでも以前なら捨てていたかもしれない役立つものに気づくようになりました。

sentences.en: Their next plan was to compare this corner with another part of the garden.
sentences.ja: 次の計画はその一角と庭の別の部分を比較することでした。

vocabulary.definition: a small part of a place
a small plant with many branches
moving something out of a place
a particular part of a place
examine things for differences and similarities

questions.prompt: What did the club originally plan to buy?
questions.explanation_ja: 店で木製のすみかを買う予定だった。

questions.prompt: What did the teacher ask the students to do first?
options: Count every animal in the town
questions.explanation_ja: まず既存の植物を注意深く見るよう求めた。

questions.prompt: What did the students leave in the garden?
questions.explanation_ja: 乾いた葉を一部残した。

questions.prompt: Why did they put up a sign?
options: To explain the different appearance of the area
To warn of a broken window
To show the time of their meetings
questions.explanation_ja: 違う見た目の理由を知らせるため。

questions.prompt: When did they visit the corner?
options: At the same time each Friday

questions.explanation_ja: 観察しても触ったり動かしたりしなかった。

questions.prompt: What did they see after the rain?
questions.explanation_ja: 雨の後に葉の下に隠れていた昆虫。

questions.prompt: Why can the club not yet claim that animal numbers increased?
options: Their observations do not establish that change
The garden was closed all year
They measured the number before and after and found it fell
questions.explanation_ja: 増えたかは不明で比較は次の計画。

questions.prompt: Which idea best fits the passage?
options: Buy new materials for every project
Keep all school gardens exactly alike
Observe existing resources before changing a garden
questions.explanation_ja: 既存のものを観察して生かし、検証する姿勢。

grammar.explanation_ja: instead of＋動名詞で「〜する代わりに」。

grammar.focus: so that other students would know

paraphrases.source: However, their teacher asked them to look carefully at what was already growing there.
paraphrases.rewrite: The teacher wanted them to observe the plants already in the garden.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 先生は既存の植物を観察させようとした。

paraphrases.source: Instead of removing everything, they decided to keep some leaves in a quiet part of the garden.
paraphrases.rewrite: They chose to leave a few leaves rather than clear the whole area.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 全部片付けるのではなく葉を残した。

paraphrases.source: They wrote down what they saw, but they did not touch or move the animals.
paraphrases.rewrite: They recorded their observations without handling the animals.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 動物に触れず記録した。

paraphrases.source: Their next plan was to compare this corner with another part of the garden.
paraphrases.rewrite: They intended to study the differences between two garden areas.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 二つの場所を比較する予定。

discourse.role_ja: 当初案と先生の提案の対照。
取り除く案から別の選択への転換。
記録と接触しないことの対照。
不確かな結果にもかかわらず得た学び。
